description: This file defines a shared informer for the 'Example' custom resource in Kubernetes, including functions to create and manage informers with optional filtering and configuration.

classes.name: ExampleInformer
classes.description: Interface providing access to a shared informer and lister for 'Example' resources.

classes.name: exampleInformer
classes.description: Implementation of the ExampleInformer interface, managing informer factory, namespace, and list options.

methods.name: NewExampleInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for 'Example' resources with default options.

methods.name: NewFilteredExampleInformer
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for 'Example' resources with custom list options.

methods.name: NewExampleInformerWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a new shared informer with additional configuration options.

methods.name: defaultInformer
methods.description: Returns the default shared index informer with namespace and list options.

methods.name: Informer
methods.description: Returns the shared index informer for 'Example' resources.
